event: 2026 ILCA 6 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: GBR 225211 was represented by Billy MORRIS
ITA 226858 was represented by Marco Valerio GRUE
Alison Young (GBR coach) attended the hearing as an observer.
Alessandro Nassironi (ITA 282844) gave evidence as a witness for ITA 226858.
facts: The wind strength was 10 to 12 knots with choppy seas and waves of about 0.5m.
GBR 225211 was on port and ITA 226858 was starboard tack sailing down wind towards gate mark 3S.
GBR 225211 was clear ahead when he entered the zone.
When the boats were 1 boat length away from the mark, ITA 226858 established an inside overlap with GBR 225211.
At that time, both boats were about half a boat length apart.
GBR 225211 gybed and her mainsheet tangled with ITA 226858's boom.
There was no damage, or injury.
conclusions: ITA 226858 not overlapped with GBR 225211 and not in the zone at the time GBR 225211 reached the zone, failed to give GBR 225211 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(2) and 14.
GBR 225211 did not avoid contact with ITA 226858 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).

Since GBR 225211 broke RRS 10 and 14, while she was sailing within the mark-room, of which she was entitled, she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(b) and 43.1(c) for her breach as contact did not cause damage or injury.
